software: Python 3.12.14; standard-library Fraction and standalone sparse Laurent/exterior implementation

mathematics.assertion_tested: Exact oriented Fourier-kernel GRR character, normalized degree-six Weil component and annihilator identities for the constructed genus-three seed.
mathematics.coefficient_domain: Q[d,d^-1,u,a,b]/(u^2+d); sparse exterior algebra over 6 and 12 generators; no floating point.
mathematics.conventions: Single-block order x1,x2,w1,w2,y1,y2; integrate y1*y2; a=-lambda on second factor; Fourier [3] contributes global minus; E duality acts by (-1)^j in codimension j.

bounds.geometric_regime: d>0; actual smooth seed uses d=176400*d0 with d0 a positive integer

non_claims: No sheaf existence is inferred from formal coefficients.
The smooth seed and coherent sheaf are constructed in the accompanying geometric proof, not by this script.
No deformation or all-period algebraicity theorem is implemented.
No canonical cycle-class formalization or all-varieties Hodge theorem is certified.

checks: The one-pair Fourier integral matches its universal polynomial formula in a,b.
The actual GRR rank is 8d and the first character has the stated R/theta signs.
Both determinant forms are primitive and absorb the mixed normalization exponential.
The full degree-six normalized character equals the displayed theta-cube plus Weil formula.
The exceptional component is rational, has 32 terms, and its all-w coefficient is -(d+1)/(2d).
All ambient normalized coefficients P0,...,P6 are rational; P0=8d, P1=0 and P3 is the displayed factor.
result: Exact symbolic identities verified; the explicit all-w coefficient proves nonvanishing for every d>0 by the separate elementary positivity argument.
residual_risks: The exterior/quotient implementation is custom; its conventions are cross-checked by the oriented one-pair integral, known sheaf rank, the paper derivation and separate Lean scalar identities.
Version 1 does not machine-instrument the host; command uses GNU timeout for its stated wall bound.
Initial launch attempts failed because Sympy was unavailable. The final script has no Sympy dependency.
